deploybot: Production deploy started for release/v3.6.7 (commit f2d4c1)

env: prod-usw2
strategy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%
initiated by: ashley

ashley (releases): Starting canary -> 5% traffic. I'll monitor the dashboards. :eyes:

mike (oncall): Observability gate set. Auto-alerts enabled, SLO dashboards linked: https://observability.example.com/d/rdw/prod-rollout

leo (sre): Ramp plan confirmed: 5% (5m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (10m). Fallback: pin 25% and rollback to release/v3.6.6 if errors > 0.5% ERR_RATE.

deploybot: Canary rollout to 5% complete. Telemetry: token-latency p50=220ms p95=420ms errors=0.03%

sara (eng): Noted a small p95 spike at t+3m (420ms -> 590ms) but traces show a single hotspot on endpoint /chunked-encode, likely cold-starts. Keeping eyes.

mike (oncall): No alerts firing. Logs look clean. :thumbsup:

ashley (releases): Okay to move to 25% in 3m unless objections.

leo (sre): Go for 25%. Watch kv-cache hitrate, it matters for throughput.

deploybot: Traffic shifted to 25%. Telemetry: p50=235ms p95=480ms errors=0.04%

sara (eng): Saw a 30s tail during the 25% shift, autoscaler spun up +2 replicas, latency normalized. Filing a follow-up issue: https://jira.example.com/browse/ENG-1429

mike (oncall): All systems green. No rollback needed.

deploybot: Traffic shift to 100% complete. Production deploy finished for release/v3.6.7 (commit f2d4c1). Duration: 12m 6s. Canary metrics: p95 avg=450ms errors=0.035%.

ashley (releases): Thanks everyone. Release notes push in 15. :tada:

leo (sre): Pinning done. Tag preserved: release/v3.6.7. Rollback runbook attached to release PR.

sara (eng): Quick note: follow-up perf tweak planned for next patch to address tail latencies.

mike (oncall): Closing monitoring ticket. Will re-open if any regressions in the next 24h.

deploybot: Final status: success. Links: CI: https://ci.example.com/builds/3456 PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/678
